ns2:course.label: Graduate Electric Viola
ns2:course.description: Study at the graduate level in electric viola. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the String faculty. Concurrent registration in an approved string ensemble for MM and DMA students (two years).
